title: manisuris tessellata var. areolata
intro: Manisuris tessellata var. areolata, commonly known as Areola Manisuris or Manisuris, is a type of flowering plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Manisuris tessellata var. areolata include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
